breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the distributed self-weight approach by integrating P(x) = ρ g A (L−x) over the length, yielding δ = ρgL²/(2E). It does not collapse the distributed load into a single concentrated end load, matching the ground truth approach.
